D004.notes: Componentwise Laplacian is the finite sum of the n pure second spatial derivatives, with the original sign convention and domain. D003 and H002 provide the required notation and existence; no wave-map equation is hidden in this definition.

D005.notes: The real density is exactly |u_t|²+Σ_j|∂_ju|² with Euclidean norms/dot products and Lebesgue spatial integration. e_t denotes its time partial derivative; joint smoothness under H002 ensures it exists through ordinary finite differentiation. No support, integrability or derivative formula is postulated by the definition.

D006.notes: The finite real energy integral has the original normalization. Finiteness is explicitly guarded by N002, which exports integrability at every positive time without mentioning E.
